name: Repo Monkey
tagline: Boils your GitHub noise down to what actually needs a human, one step each
description: It sweeps your GitHub notifications, open PRs and CI runs, then returns a short list of items that genuinely need a person, each with one concrete next step. Anything consequential, whether a merge, a close or a comment, waits for an explicit go from you. Fewer tabs, fewer missed reviews.
author: Keranik
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
